findings.claim: The archived Needle registry snapshot contains 62 tools: 51 active and 11 locked. Active-tool argument arity is exactly 8 with zero args, 30 with one, 10 with two and 3 with three.
findings.implication: The historical runtime tool surface is compact and shallow enough to be represented as an explicit typed registry projection; locked/unavailable capabilities should be removed before classification rather than offered and rejected after generation.

findings.claim: The 2026-08-07 Zero-Shot report states that Needle receives the tool list as a runtime generate() argument, with a dedicated TOOLS marker and training-time permutation of tool and parameter order. On that basis it concludes registry changes do not require finetuning.
findings.implication: Treat dynamic registry conditioning as the default integration hypothesis, but reproduce it against the exact retained Needle checkpoint/source before freezing implementation semantics.

findings.claim: The 2026-08-04 architecture report says 1449 of 3785 training responses (38.3%) contained tool calls wholly or partly and 559 contained multiple calls, motivating removal of tool-call generation from FRANK's model training path.
findings.implication: When the final Clay-native corpus is built, tool mechanics should not be silently retained as a large target-generation class. Preserve separate observation/result semantics and explicitly test whether reclaimed capacity benefits self/goal/world reasoning.

findings.claim: The 2026-08-04 architecture/target documents report v26.1 tool-choice accuracy of 79.9% on 134 mandatory cases and define a >=90% Needle gate, while the later 2026-08-07 Zero-Shot report gives 67.9% (91/134) for its Stage-A baseline and argues the correct Needle success criterion is parity within 3 points on reflex cases plus at least 5x latency reduction and no canary regression.
findings.implication: Do not merge these percentages. Preserve benchmark version/probe definitions and treat the later document as a changed evaluation framing unless raw evaluation lineage proves identical scoring.

findings.claim: The 2026-08-07 report leaves direct German zero-shot behavior, exact encoder headroom under a 1024-token limit, and whether constrained decoding binds outputs to the supplied tool names as explicit pre-build gates rather than completed results.
findings.implication: These must not be promoted as solved historical facts. The current integration should test exact checkpoint/tokenizer/tool projection behavior or intentionally supersede the old direct-German assumption through an explicit boundary design.

findings.claim: The current FRANK Clay-Native contract retains Needle as the sole intentional non-Clay semantic subsystem but requires its output to become a typed provenance-bound Clay observation/proposal and explicitly forbids Needle from minting execution authority.
findings.implication: Historical Needle routing logic is reusable only behind the current proposal-versus-authority separation. A valid tool classification is never itself permission to execute an effect.

findings.claim: The later report observes that historical 4B errors concentrate on judgment-heavy/delegation tools while simple reflex tools were already near-perfect, undermining a one-router-for-everything accuracy narrative.
findings.implication: Evaluate routing by function class: fast deterministic/reflex classification, uncertainty/abstention, and escalation for semantic judgment should be measured separately rather than collapsed into one aggregate tool-choice score.

earned_work_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Historical Needle registry, benchmark lineage, dataset accounting and routing architecture provide a concrete non-greenfield classifier integration/evaluation foundation and expose which gates remain unproven.
earned_work_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Exact retained Needle checkpoint/source must pass dynamic-tool-list, constrained-name, latency, canary and uncertainty/escalation tests under the current Clay authority bridge; otherwise the historical integration assumptions do not transfer.

progress_accounting.reason: Needle direct Drive shard is closed, but external Needle source replication and global recursive denominators remain open.
